verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਟਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੁਤੇ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੇ ਚਕੋਰ ਗਤਿ ਪਲ ਨ ਲਗਤ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: eik Tak dhiaan hute cha(n)dhrame chakor gat pal na lagat supanai hoo(n) na dhikhaieeaai ||

en.bdb: I used to see my beloved Lord without a blink of the eye as a ruddy sheldrake looks at moon. There used to be no break. But now I don't even see Him in a dream.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਤਿ ਹੀ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਮਾਨ ਤਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੰਦੇਸੋ ਪਥਕਨ ਪੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat bachan dhun sunat hee bidhayamaan taa mukh sa(n)dheso pathakan pai na paieeaai ||

en.bdb: Previously, I used to hear the melody of my beloved's sweet words from His mouth, but now I do not even receive His messages even from the passers by coming or going this way.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਨ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਤੋ ਹਾਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਹਾਰ ਓਟ ਭਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sihajaa samai na ur a(n)tar samaato haar anik pahaar oT bhe kaise jaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Previously, even the interference of the necklace around my neck was not tolerated between us at the time of our meeting on the nuptial bed, but now many mountain size customs have come up between us. How can I raise them down and reach my beloved Lord?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਹੁਤੇ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਲਲਾਈਐ ॥੬੭੦॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj sa(n)jog bhog ras parataap hute bireh biyog sog rog bilalaieeaai ||670||

en.bdb: Previously in my spiritual tranquility, I had the happiness and bliss of being near Him, but I am now crying with pangs of separation.  (670)
